fit.gpuHint: The model fits in your graphics card memory: this is the fastest case.
fit.mixedHint: The model does not fit entirely in the graphics card: part of it goes through system memory, which slows generation down.
fit.cpuHint: No usable graphics card: the model runs on the processor with system memory. It works but stays slow.
fit.tooBigHint: The model exceeds the available memory (VRAM + 70% of RAM): it may fail to load.
